cover.coreProposition: Artifact publication should model reservation, staged completeness, reader visibility and durable persistence as separate lifecycle facts: pending isolation plus atomic rename can establish process-level visibility under stated filesystem assumptions, but rename success is not crash-durability evidence and abandoned-state recovery needs independent ownership proof.
cover.visualMetaphor: A finished glass artifact appearing through an open aperture while its heavy foundation remains visibly unsettled below
cover.semanticObject: One complete luminous object that is fully visible above a still-unlocked structural base
cover.compositionIntent: Serious landscape editorial cover with one dominant artifact, restrained stone and teal materials, strong foreground-background depth and clear thumbnail recognition
